If you specify this canned ACL when creating a bucket, Amazon S3 ignores it.

help.title: Help & Guide
help.subtitle: Guide to install Rclone and WinFSP
help.rcloneInfo: Rclone is a command-line program to manage files on cloud storage. This UI relies on it. You need to download it and add it to your system PATH.
help.winfspInfo: Mounting cloud drives as local disks on Windows requires WinFSP. Without it, the mount feature will not work.
help.rcloneStep1: Click the button below to download the Rclone zip archive.
help.rcloneStep2: Extract it to your preferred location (e.g., C:\rclone).
help.rcloneStep3: Add that directory to your system PATH environment variable, and verify with rclone --version.
help.winfspStep1: Click the button below to visit the official WinFSP release page.
help.winfspStep3: Run the installer and follow the wizard to complete the installation.
help.rcloneStep1_linux: Open terminal and run the install script: curl https://rclone.org/install.sh | sudo bash
help.rcloneStep2_linux: For mounting, ensure fuse is installed (e.g. sudo apt install fuse3).
help.rcloneStep3_linux: Run rclone --version to verify the installation.
help.rcloneStep1_macos: Open terminal and install via Homebrew: brew install rclone
help.rcloneStep2_macos: For mounting, please install macFUSE (brew install --cask macfuse).
help.rcloneStep3_macos: Run rclone --version to verify the installation.
help.macfuseInfo: Mounting cloud drives on macOS requires macFUSE.
help.macfuseStep1: Visit the macFUSE website to download the .dmg installer.
help.macfuseStep2: Run it and allow the kernel extension in "Security & Privacy".
help.macfuseStep3: Restart your Mac for the changes to take effect.
